svg.title: The life-crm framework, as a metro map
svg.desc: Three lines meet at one Google Sheet. The build line runs from your sources through the AI agent to the sheet and its workspace. The daily line links you, your chat assistant and the sheet. The publish line takes the sheet to your dashboard and back to you, and through the Cloudflare login to an optional public page. Zone 1 is private, zone 2 is public.
svg.text: the AI agent builds and updates it
you, your assistant and the sheet
the sheet shown back to you
